output.title: Drawing viewer shows old revision after ECO release
output.applies_when: After an ECO or drawing release, the viewer still shows the previous revision (e.g. revision B) instead of the newly released one.

steps.text: Confirm the symptom: the drawing was released, but the viewer still shows the old revision of the part number.

quotes.quote: ECO released this morning but the viewer still shows revision B of 330-005527.
Plant sees the old drawing in the viewer after release.

steps.text: Clear the viewer cache on the server.

quotes.quote: Cleared viewer cache on the server
Cleared viewer cache on the server

steps.text: Refresh the viewer and check that the new revision now shows.

unknowns: Which server hosts the viewer cache, and the exact procedure or tool used to clear it.
Who has permission to clear the server cache (which team or role), and how to request it.
Whether clearing the cache can be scoped to a single drawing or clears it for all users, and any impact or downtime.
Whether the user also needs to refresh or clear their local browser or client cache.
Why the cache goes stale after release (root cause) and whether a permanent fix is planned. This occurred in 83 tickets in 12 months and is rising: 21 in the last 3 months versus 16 in the 3 before.
Expected time for the new revision to appear after release before a ticket should be raised. Median resolution is 53.6 hours.
Escalation path if clearing the cache and refreshing does not show the new revision.
